evidence_notes.research_setup: Smaller company ($1M-$20M traded a day) + 2 or more insiders each buying $25k+ within 30 days + operating cash flow above reported profit. evidence_notes.insider_cluster: 2 or more insiders bought within 30 days. Tested: an edge in smaller companies ($1M-$20M traded a day) in both periods; in larger companies the edge faded after 2022; below $1M a day it was not tested.
